sentences.text:
------
Order No.02 Dated : 18.05.2023 Heard both the sides.

The petitioner- Pintu Yadav is in custody since 15.02.2023 in connection with Barhi P.S. Case No. 72 of 2023 for the offence registered under Sections 376, 498A of the I.P.C. and Sections 3 & 4 of D.P.
Act pending in the Court of learned J.M. 1st Class, Hazaribag.

It is submitted by the learned counsel on behalf of petitioner that offence under Section 376 of the I.P.C. will not be made out as per the allegation made in the F.I.R. wherein it has been stated that the victim was major girl and on promise of marriage, he established consensual physical relationship with her for last 5-6 months.
Later, they were married and thereafter, dowry demand was made by the accused and his family members.
Learned A.P.P. opposed the prayer for bail.

Under the circumstances, the above named petitioner is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Court below.
